params.message:
One save for the context and the properties

The panel saved each property the moment it was tapped and the context
with its own button inside the left column. Two ways of saving in one
panel left it unclear what was kept, and the button sat under the
context only.

- Tapping Groep, Belang, Draagt or a colleague changes the panel; one
  Bewaren under both columns keeps the note and the properties together.
  "Nog niet bewaard" shows until then.
- Bewaren with only properties changed keeps them and leaves the item
  open; with a note it moves on, as before. Niets bijzonders keeps the
  tapped properties too.
